# DDR classifier preparation (real-data)

This source requires the original DDR images and `DR_grading.csv`, which are NOT included.

Set `DDR_IMG_DIR`, `DDR_CSV`, `DDR_OUTDIR`, then run:

```bash
python make_ddr_scores_deduplicated.py
```

**Do not claim the existing historical score pool was generated by this script.**
A definitive analysis needs the new scoring recipe, checkpoint, audit, split manifest,
and near-duplicate review/conservative screening records. See the root README.

For a reviewed run, use `DDR_REVIEWED_DUPLICATES`, `DDR_PHASH_REPORT`, and
`DDR_NEARDUP_REVIEW_COMPLETE=1` as appropriate. For conservative exclusion,
`DDR_AUTOMATIC_NEARDUP_EXCLUSION=1` and `DDR_PHASH_REPORT` are required.
See code for required report schema.
